key_highlights: ASX finishes the week higher, anchored by major bank shares capitalizing on wide deposit margins.
Intensifying retail divergence as Woolworths gains market share while Coles faces heavy valuation losses.
Aggressive residential property price drops across Sydney and Melbourne amplify downside risks for household balance sheets.
Persistent RBA rate pressure and global energy volatility keep consumer discretionary and cyclical sectors subdued.

sectors.trend: Major banks benefit from elevated cash rates and sticky deposit spreads despite slowing credit expansion.
sectors.implications: Short-term earnings resilience for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, and ANZ.AX; longer-term headwinds from rising mortgage arrears.

sectors.trend: Sharp bifurcation between defensive staples and discretionary retail; Coles loses market share to Woolworths.
sectors.implications: Favor WOW.AX over COL.AX; maintain underweight stance on consumer discretionary amid tightening household budgets.

sectors.trend: Auction clearance rates fall to multi-year lows as Sydney home values drop 10% in under eight months.
sectors.implications: Downward valuation pressure on residential REITs and property developers; debt servicing risks rise.

sectors.trend: Middle East geopolitical friction and domestic gas market constraints create supply-side price pressure.
sectors.implications: Constructive backdrop for upstream producers WDS.AX and STO.AX, though domestic policy interventions remain a risk.

sectors.trend: Speculative junior gold and critical minerals exploration gains attention while iron ore sentiment faces macro headwinds.
sectors.implications: Defensive tier-one miners like BHP.AX and RIO.AX offer balance sheet protection over high-cost juniors.

key_themes: RBA restrictive monetary policy straining consumer discretionary cash flows.
Banking margin strength offsetting broader macroeconomic softness on the ASX 200.
Accelerating residential property correction impacting consumer wealth effects.
Energy security and gas supply shortages driving commodity price premia.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight consumer discretionary and cyclical retail; overweight cash-generative staples and infrastructure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Downturn & Asset Quality Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to residential development REITs; monitor bank mortgage provisioning closely.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical Energy Shock and Domestic Gas Shortages
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hold energy producers with unhedged upstream volume exposure (WDS.AX, STO.AX).
Prioritize low-cost producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) with diversified mineral revenue streams.

opportunities.recommendation: Pairs Trade: Long WOW.AX / Short COL.AX
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths is winning grocery market share while Coles faces execution issues and market capitalization erosion.
Geopolitical standoff in Iran and Australian domestic supply deficits support realized hydrocarbon prices.
Major banks continue harvesting wide net interest margins from high deposit balances.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Consumer Discretionary and Retail REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer spending contraction and falling home values pose continuing threats to discretionary revenues.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Allocate to Bond Duration and AUD Hedges
defensive_moves.rationale: Provide downside insurance against domestic growth deceleration and residential property corrections.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain range-bound near term as bank strength balances retail and real estate softness.
market_outlook.long_term: A multi-speed economic environment where defensive yields, quality energy assets, and low-cost miners outperform domestic cyclicals.
key_catalysts: Next RBA monetary policy statement and official cash rate decision
Quarterly CPI print and domestic retail trade figures
Federal government energy market interventions and gas policy announcements
China industrial activity indicators and iron ore import demand
watch_list: RBA cash rate expectations and interbank futures pricing
Sydney and Melbourne residential auction clearance rates and CoreLogic home value index
AUD/USD response to US Federal Reserve rate pause and commodity spreads
Brent crude benchmarks and domestic wholesale gas spot prices
